<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.58.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [chore] Remove deprecated `add_rows` feature by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15034
* [chore] Remove langchain callback handler integration by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15051
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] Add custom script error handling via `st.App` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14972
* [feature] Add `st.pagination` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14975
* [feat] Add `type` parameter to st.expander and st.status for compact style by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14054
* [feature][ParallelFragments] Add parallel=True dispatch to [USER].fragment by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15214
* [feature] Add API restrictions for parallel fragments by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15251
* [feature] Add `streamlit skills` CLI command by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15116
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] Selectbox first item hidden when 7 options selected by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14997
* [fix] Defer sys.modules eviction to script-run boundary (#14593) by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14826
* [fix] OAuth MismatchingStateError regression in 1.57.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15048
* [fix] Programmatically closed popovers/expanders reopening on interaction with another by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14945
* [fix] Support symlinks in Starlette static file serving by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15112
* [feature] Sync URL when session_state updates query-param-bound widgets by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14744
* fix: add usedforsecurity=False to blake2b for FIPS compatibility by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15149
* fix(fragment): prevent stale auto-reruns from crashing apps by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15130
* [fix] Block javascript: and vbscript: URLs in markdown links by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15161
* Set Max-Age on st.login() cookies to restore 30-day persistence by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15194
* [fix] Fix Vega-Lite chart tooltips in dialogs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15191
* [fix] Help icon for unsafe_allow_html=True in st.markdown by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15232
* [fix] Discover script-level .streamlit/config.toml when st.App runs under uvicorn by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15218
* [fix] Warn when st.button shortcut is browser-reserved by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15217
* fix(auth): migrate provider tokens to joserfc by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15178
* Fix browser Back/Forward navigation for pages with Unicode URL paths by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15281
* [fix] Restore Starlette OAuth PKCE behavior by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15282
* [fix] Disable Select all in multiselect for >=1000 options by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15301
* Fix accidental overscrolling in table, dataframe, and data_editor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15309
### Other Changes
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14948
* [chore] Release v1.57.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14962
* [fix] Reduce external IP fetch timeout to avoid startup freeze by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14984
* Adjust widget/icon sizing - Part 1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15056
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15134
* Adjust widget/icon sizing - Part 2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15098
* [chore] Update emojis/material icons by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15236

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/14927
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15149
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/15194
